messages:
alex_sales: Heads-up: Solstice (partner) requested a co-sell POC — Redwood Dedicated in their AWS account via VPC peering, SAML SSO, CMK/HSM, telemetry to Splunk, and a simple pricing sketch for bursty events. Can we do a 20m tech handoff tomorrow? cc @ola_partner

ola_partner: Thanks Alex. Must-haves: data stays in our VPC, EU primary (Frankfurt), p90 <=150ms for single-turn assistant calls. Typical ctx ~512 tokens, occasional 2048 spikes. Need per-tenant audit logs and per-route telemetry. Provisioning lead time ok around 10 business days.

maria_se: I can own presales. Quick clarifier: expected steady-state QPS vs peak concurrency? Also acceptable to use warmers/prefix cache? Plan: (1) sandbox: 1 small GPU + hosted fallback, (2) pilot: 3 reserved GPUs, KV cache, canary routing. Deliverables: ASCII topology, SAML/OIDC flow, egress IP list, k6/curl load snippet, security questionnaire answers.

alex_sales: They said baseline ~18 qps, burst ~160-220 concurrent first month. Warmers OK; p90 target <150ms.

devin_eng: Ops notes: recommend 3-month pilot with 50% baseline commit + burst credits billed at usage with 20% partner discount for pilot. Provisioning lead time ~8-10 business days; if they want faster start use hosted fallback. Telemetry: can stream aggregated token counts, per-tenant latency histograms, and sampled traces to their Splunk (no raw PII). We'll provide telemetry schema + sampling guidance.

devin_eng: Quick topology sketch (ASCII):
Partner VPC <-> VPC peering -> Redwood Dedicated subnet -> regional gateway -> tenant routing -> dedicated pool
Fallback -> Hosted model fleet (circuit-breaker)

maria_se: Security questionnaire arrived. They want SOC2 control mappings, key locality, and network/evidence for audit logs. Can Redwood support CMK/HSM?

ops-bot: Confirmed: customer-managed KMS/HSM supported for Private/Dedicated deployments. SOC2 pack link: https://s3.redwood.example/soc2-pack.pdf. Eng-security review queued (48h).

maria_se: I'll compile SOC2 answers and coordinate eng-security. Devin please draft the egress/IP whitelist diagram and a short cover memo.

devin_eng: Will do. Also preparing a tiny load command for initial smoke tests:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"rwd-v1-large","input":"Summarize this message","max_tokens":256}'
```

alex_sales: Plan: 1) Kickoff call tomorrow 10:00 PT \/ confirm? 2) Maria: SOC2 + questionnaire by EOD. 3) Devin: topology + load harness + egress diagram by EOD. 4) Ola: confirm partner CIDR block, Splunk collector endpoint, and SSO contact.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "Solstice joint POC kickoff" 2026-04-06 10:00 PT. Invites: alex_sales, maria_se, devin_eng, ola_partner, eng-security.

alex_sales: Thanks all \/ I'll turn this into a 1-pager runbook and share before the call. :thumbsup:
